keyFindings.description: The test does not pin which clone stays: a last-writer-wins mutant (loser rm's the landed clone and renames its own into place at workspace.ts:156) passes 5/5. Fix: write a `clone-origin` marker into each fake clone's .jj (after line 250) and assert `readFile(jjDir/clone-origin) === cloneTargets[0]` (after line 276); verified 10/10 pass vs real code, 5/5 fail vs mutant, suite 13/13.
